create_unknown_field_set_from_message: create an UnknownFieldSet from a protobuf message to inspect unrecognized fields
iterate_unknown_fields: iterate over an UnknownFieldSet to access each unknown field's wire type and data
access_unknown_field_properties: access the field_number, wire_type, and data properties of an UnknownField instance
index_unknown_field_set: index into an UnknownFieldSet by position to retrieve a specific unknown field
get_unknown_field_set_length: get the number of unknown fields in an UnknownFieldSet using len()
